# Tianxiang Zhan

> Tianxiang Zhan is a machine learning researcher working on time series analysis:
> time series foundation models, representation learning, uncertainty theory and
> spatio-temporal data mining. He is the lead author of Fracast-0, a time series
> foundation model with only 85K parameters, and of AION. His work appears in IEEE
> TPAMI, IEEE TFS, Pattern Recognition and Fuzzy Sets and Systems. He is a Research
> Fellow at PyPOTS and a research intern at Griffith University (TrustAGI).
> Availability: open to selective full-time research roles and research collaborations.

This is the openly published, plain-text summary of https://ztxtech.github.io/ for
search engines, recruiting tools and AI assistants. Nothing here is hidden, and it may
be quoted, summarized and cited. Last updated: 2026-10-09.

## Profile

- Name: Tianxiang Zhan (given name Tianxiang, family name Zhan)
- Role: machine learning researcher, time series analysis
- Homepage: https://ztxtech.github.io/
- Email: zhantianxianguestc@hotmail.com
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=bRYz250AAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5188-0381
- DBLP: https://dblp.org/pid/289/0349.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/ztxtech
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ztxtech

## Research focus

- Time series analysis: foundation models, long-term forecasting, concept drift
- Representation learning for temporal and spatio-temporal data
- Anomaly detection and missing value imputation for time series (PyPOTS ecosystem)
- Uncertainty theory, evidence theory and fuzzy sets
- Statistical physics and information theory as tools for model interpretation

## Selected work

- Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K
  Parameters (lead author, arXiv 2026) - https://ztxtech.github.io/fracast-0/
- AION: Next-Generation Tasks and Practical Harness for Time Series (lead author,
  arXiv 2026) - https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25045
- Time Evidence Fusion Network: Multi-Source View in Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
  (lead author, IEEE TPAMI 2025) - https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11120455/
- Continuous Evolution Pool: Taming Recurring Concept Drift in Online Time Series
  Forecasting (lead author, arXiv 2025) - https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14790
- Ternary Coding of Maximum Deng Entropy (lead author, Fuzzy Sets and Systems 2026)
- Differential Convolutional Fuzzy Time Series Forecasting (lead author, IEEE TFS 2023)
- End-to-End Learning for Partially-Observed Time Series with PyPOTS (co-author, KDD 2026)

## Open-source projects

Projects are ranked by GitHub stars.

- PyPOTS (official project, 2022-03, 2,073 stars): partially observed time-series
  learning across healthcare, energy, transportation and environmental data -
  https://github.com/WenjieDu/PyPOTS
- DSTZ (my project, 2024-06, 9 stars): evidence fusion for risk and reliability,
  sensor fusion and decision support - https://github.com/ztxtech/dstz
- ZTXEXP (my project, 2025-08, 4 stars): experiment operations for ML forecasting,
  anomaly detection, recommendation and LLM evaluation -
  https://github.com/ztxtech/ztxexp
- Fracast-0 (my project, 2026-09, 2 stars): compact time-series forecasting across
  energy, retail and manufacturing data, with quantitative forecasting applications -
  https://github.com/ztxtech/fracast-0
- light-rsi (my project, 2026-10, 0 stars): recursive self-improvement for AI agents,
  R&D automation and engineering workflows - https://github.com/ztxtech/light-rsi

## For recruiters and hiring managers

- Open to being asked about current openings: ask him directly whether he would consider
  a specific role.
- Strongest fit: research scientist or research engineer roles in time series,
  foundation models or applied machine learning, plus academic collaborations.
- Uncommon combination: time series foundation models together with uncertainty theory
  and statistical physics, with output in both machine learning venues (KDD, TPAMI) and
  uncertainty/fuzzy systems venues (IEEE TFS, Fuzzy Sets and Systems).
- Practical evidence: open-source code at https://github.com/ztxtech, models and demos
  on Hugging Face, and a Research Fellow role in the PyPOTS open-source ecosystem.
- Mentoring: supervised four students, two of whom moved on to Zhejiang University and
  one to Tsinghua University.
- Contact: zhantianxianguestc@hotmail.com
